notes: Found that real, live, per-system EOA/EOS data already exists in Active IQ's API (hardwareModel.endOfAvailability/endOfSupport) and is already correctly harvested -- 371/484 real systems (77%) have it -- but the 'Risk 504' EOA finding never used it, always falling back to a separate, frozen manual snapshot with a generic staleness caveat even when a real date was available on the same system. Fixed to prefer the real date when Active IQ reports one. Also live-tested GetProductMilestones (a schema field that looked like it might restore a live EOA/EOS-by-part-number lookup) against 4 real part numbers -- every one returned 403 Forbidden from the underlying service, confirming it's not accessible with a partner-level token and ruling it out as a source.
